Class MoMSolverDispatcher

java.lang.Object
solvers.control.MoMSolverDispatcher
public class MoMSolverDispatcher extends Object
This class implements the API to allow use by other applications. One can define the queueing network model details, call the solvers transparently and, afterwards, read the results.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010

  • Method Details

    • input

      public boolean input(int[] t, double[][] s, double[][] v, int nThreads)
      Initializes the solver with the system parameters. It must be called before trying to solve the model.
      Parameters:
      t - array of the types (LD or LI) of service centers
      s - matrix of service times of the service centers
      v - array of visits to the service centers
      nThreads - The number of threads the solver should use. If nThreads > 2 then the parallel algorithm is used.
      Returns:
      True if the operation is completed with success

    • solve

      public void solve() throws InternalErrorException, OperationNotSupportedException, InconsistentLinearSystemException, BTFMatrixErrorException
      Solves the system through the MoM algorithm. input(...) must have been called first.
      Throws:
      InternalErrorException
      BTFMatrixErrorException
      InconsistentLinearSystemException
      OperationNotSupportedException
